question: In a certain code language, LOVE is written as NQXG. How will SWEET be written as in that language?
solution:
The positional values of the English alphabet are as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0feadec6334417d48300e8b565d1c1d9e73015cad02726ea6b55b6976b18ed05.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

LOVE is written as NQXG

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ba024eab30261129cc749f77900ffda14b653a102bfedc1ef9f6cb9e7b0ed7b1.png] 

Similarly, SWEET will be written as:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/da2c305249eb104db888705a4a6c2bdb59d8f126a14544c095f0921edfc07835.png] 

Hence,** 'option 3'** is the correct answer.
